record.title: Somaliland COVID land-border closure order March 2020
record.scope: Land frontiers with Ethiopia and Djibouti and the explicitly disputed/de facto boundary with Somalia
record.crossings: Land frontiers with Ethiopia and Djibouti and the explicitly disputed/de facto boundary with Somalia
record.direction: Regional entry and exit; June statement expressly describes both.
record.exceptions: Essential food, fuel, water, medicines and health goods.
record.relationship: Separate imposing authority from H07 Ethiopia, H11 Djibouti and H12 Gedo; overlapping counterpart policies are not independent country counts.

record.context: De facto authority is recorded separately from Somalia federal or neighbouring-state orders.
record.uncertainty: March lead sentence says immediate closure on 25 March; operative clause starts 26 March at 18:00. Three-week initial term is not treated as actual reopening. Extension sequence and operational endpoint are unverified.
